reason: Chrome Search fails before native Double Shift: AT-SPI reports text length 5/1 with caret 6/2, while a separately pinned post-verdict DOM read reports complete text and matching end caret. Ordinary input agrees across both readers. Sequential samples do not establish a precise Chromium defect.
decision: Qualify a separately versioned read-only client-text observer. Select its transport before physical input, never as a fallback after a failed assertion. A DOM transport must pin browser PID/start/profile, loopback listener, WebSocket and exact fixture page before and after a read. The shared pure state contract validates exact URL, field, type, document focus, unmodified text and UTF-16 selection boundaries. Keep the original physical-input, window/field focus, layout, engine, decoder and Backspace checks. Retain raw AT-SPI observations as diagnostics. Do not let target() recover from a failed DOM result through a second reader.
rejected: Append a character in Lay: the DOM already contains the full word.
Extend GetText boundaries: three bounded reads still return truncated Search text.
Increase waits without new evidence: the existing target loop already observes the mismatch for approximately two seconds.
Pick whichever reader matches the expected result: this could hide a real conversion failure.
verification: Run pure malformed/identity/focus/selection/Unicode negative controls plus actual actor entrypoint and no-reader-fallback controls remotely. First execute a separate fixed ordinary/Search roundtrip/short diagnostic with real native input and unchanged runtime bytes. Preserve old FAILs and NOT_TESTED. A later full browser matrix requires the new observer SHA and separately recorded dependency identity; do not splice diagnostic PASS into the old 432.
not_tested: Native112 not rerun in this observer version; GNOME; Firefox DOM transport; DOM field types other than Chrome text/Search; visual pixels; production installation. Earlier native112 receipt retained separately. Selected-range conversion remains failing.
rollback: Remove the added test-only state adapter and use the previous immutable actor. Keep both versions and all original receipts.
